objective.title: Qualify independent local Math V1 G-M5 scientific gate

declared.summary: Qualify LOCAL G-M5: independently verify seven phases, 14 tasks, 42 substages, ten V1 criteria, 17 scientific witnesses and 12 publication/adoption refusal oracles. Run locked Release build, five focused suites, full .NET solution tests, seven SHA-inspected local NuGet archives and three eight-probe source-free clients. Complete only M5's local scientific milestone; preview.4 stays unpublished, other OSs/ABIs unqualified, recipients unsent and stable/public 1.0 unauthorized.
declared.value: Independently prove the bounded local Math V1 milestone and seven-package source-free consumer graph before M6 scientific expansion, while preserving public release and downstream adoption as separate owner decisions.
debtChanges: Verify all seven accepted M5 phases, 14 tasks and 42 substages against backlog, DWF, previous M0-M4 gates and source-linked Math scientific receipts.
Preserve ten bounded V1 criteria, 17 witnessed facts and 12 owner/recipient refusal oracles; do not infer public release or external adoption.
Execute the original two independent V1/publication validators and new G-M5 gate before and after native milestone completion.
At this milestone boundary, run locked .NET Release build, five focused regressions and the full admitted solution test suite.
Repack seven local net10 Math packages, recheck real NuGet dependencies, README/NOTICE and exact archive byte SHA-256.
Run three distinct source-free NuGet consumers with eight independent probes each: API surface, clean archive audit, exact numerical/symbolic console.
Complete M5 only as a LOCAL science gate. Keep preview.4 unchanged and stable/public NuGet, unknown RIDs, cross-version ABI and recipients unpromoted.
declared.nextAction: After durable RS080 success, prepare M6-W01-C01-T1 bounded interpolation/least-squares work; defer stable/public release pending separate owner authorization.
